The '''R18 Division''' was a reconnaissance mobile armored [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The R18 Division utilized [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] to carry out reconnaissance missions and as support in defense of important Separatist assets.

The division was assigned to fulfill its defensive objectives as support to [[Y66 Division]] with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] piloting AATs. However, when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]] destroyed Y66's forces during the second wave of the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], himself in an AAT, ordered the retreat of the R18 Division until the powering up of massive [[Force field/Legends|force field]] generators to provide protection against the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|artillery cannons]].
